questions.question: Identify the central theme of the passage.
questions.questionHtml: Identify the central theme of the passage.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Description of lifestyle of sparrows'.
 
Key Points
  • The passage provides an overview of sparrows, including their size, the variety observed in their species, and their widespread presence worldwide.
  • It details aspects of their nesting habits, such as the materials used for nest construction and typical nesting sites, which contributes to understanding their lifestyle.
  • The reproduction process is described, including egg characteristics and care for the young, highlighting the parental behaviour of sparrows.
  • The dietary habits of sparrows, both for adults and young ones, are discussed, emphasizing their reliance on seeds and insects.
  • The passage concludes by mentioning the affection many people around the world have for sparrows, tying back to their interaction with human environments.
  • Hence, the central theme for the given passage is 'Description of lifestyle of sparrows'.
Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 1'.
 
Additional Information
  • Description of sparrows’ nest: While the passage does discuss the construction and location of sparrows' nests, this theme is only one part of the broader topic of their lifestyle. The focus is not solely on their nests.
  • Different shortcomings of sparrows: The passage does not mention any shortcomings of sparrows. Instead, it provides a neutral or positive overview of their characteristics and behaviours.
  • Availability of sparrows: Although it mentions that sparrows can be found nearly anywhere there are people, the passage focuses more on the lifestyle of sparrows rather than merely stating their widespread availability.

questions.question: How many eggs are laid by female sparrows at a time?

  • This detail is part of the broader description of the reproduction process of sparrows.
  • It further elaborates on the appearance of the eggs, noting they have reddish-brown blotches on white shells.
  • The passage also covers the incubation period, which ranges from eleven to fourteen days, indicating the care taken by sparrows towards their offspring.

  • Six to eight: This option exceeds the correct range of eggs laid by female sparrows.
  • Eight to ten: This option significantly overestimates the number of eggs female sparrows lay at a time, according to the information provided in the passage.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Melody
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Melody
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Disharmony'.
 
Key Points
  • Melody refers to a sequence of pleasing musical notes that form a coherent whole, creating a memorable and enjoyable tune. (मधुर संगीत)
    • Example: The melody of her favorite song always brought a smile to her face.
  • Disharmony signifies a lack of harmony, concord, or agreement; it refers to when musical notes sound in conflict with each other instead of forming a pleasant whole. (विषमता)
    • Example: The musicians struggled to play together, resulting in disharmony that was unpleasant to the listeners.
  • Hence, the correct antonym is Disharmony.
Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 3'.
 
Additional Information
  • Musicality (संगीतात्मकता) refers to the quality of having a pleasant sound; it is about being musical or having the qualities of music itself.
  • Symphony (सहवादन) is a long piece of music that is usually in four parts and performed by an orchestra.
  • Ballad (गीतिकाव्य) is a type of song or poem that narrates a story in short stanzas.

questions.question: Identify a suitable title for the passage.
questions.questionHtml: Identify a suitable title for the passage.

Key Points
  • The passage encompasses various aspects of sparrows' existence, including their physical characteristics, nesting habits, reproductive behaviours, and dietary preferences.
  • It provides a comprehensive overview of the lifecycle and habits of sparrows rather than focusing on a single aspect.
  • The title "The Lives Of Sparrows" encapsulates the broad range of topics covered in the passage, making it the most suitable choice.

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 4'.
 
Additional Information
  • Song of Sparrows: While catchy, this title suggests a focus on the vocalizations of sparrows, which is not the central theme of the passage.
  • How Sparrows Build Nests: This title is too narrow, only addressing one aspect of the sparrows' lives covered in the passage.

questions.question: Identify the tone of the passage.
questions.questionHtml: Identify the tone of the passage.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Descriptive'.
 
Key Points
  • The passage provides detailed information on various aspects of the lifestyle of sparrows, including their physical characteristics, nesting habits, reproductive behaviours, dietary habits, and their interaction with human environments.
  • It employs clear and informative language to convey factual content about sparrows, focusing on delivering knowledge rather than analyzing it, making fun of it, or entertaining the reader with humour.
  • The use of descriptive language aims to paint a vivid picture of sparrows' lives for the reader, without delving into critical analysis or employing satire or humour.
Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 2'.
 
Additional Information
  • Analytical: This tone would suggest a more critical or in-depth examination of the topic, which is not the primary approach of the passage.
  • Satiric: A satiric tone would imply the use of humor, irony, exaggeration, or ridicule to critique, which does not align with the passage's straightforward and factual style.
  • Humorous: While the passage might be engaging, its primary purpose is not to entertain by making the reader laugh or amused, which would be indicative of a humorous tone.
